scientific_integrity: Classical renewal entropy formulas and Sturmian factor complexity are credited. Diagnostic computations are finite; the all-parameter assertions rely on the analytic proof. Historical priority requires independent bibliographic assessment.
scientific_limitations: For binary S-gap shifts whose allowed zero-run lengths follow the lower mechanical coding of an irrational slope; normalized finite-type cover entropy only. No uniform-in-slope error or result for arbitrary S-gap patterns.
title: Exact geometric Cantor gaps in the finite-cover entropy spectrum of Sturmian gap shifts
